name: marm-memory
description: Local-first 3-in-1 AI memory layer & MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Gemini, VS Code and Cursor. Fuses session history, codebase indexing & concept graphs in SQLite. Enables zero-cloud, privacy-first context & instant recall, supports multi-agent swarms.

paragraphs: Contributions welcome! Browse open issues to contribute, or join the MARM Discord to share workflows, get setup help, and connect with other builders.
Your AI forgets everything. MARM Memory doesn't.

marm-memory gives your agents a private, shared memory for the context that normally gets lost between chats: decisions, research, fixes, notes, and project history. Switch from Claude Code to Codex or Gemini without losing the context already gathered.
features: 🧠 Core Memory (8 tools) stores conversations, notes, notebook entries, and summaries so they stay searchable.

💻 Code Graph (6 tools) maps your repository so agents can find symbols, follow code paths, and understand the project without rereading it all. Point it at a repo once and it keeps itself current as you work.
🧩 Concept Graph (2 tools) connects people, decisions, errors, and ideas from your stored memories, with links back to relevant code when available. It builds itself as you store memories.

requirements.text: > Docker HTTP requires an API key because it exposes MARM as a network server; STDIO stays local to the client process and does not need one.

The other checks: the operator's auto-apply switch is on; the proposal is re-resolved when the decision is made and is still new; one line of 12 to 300 characters; nothing that looks like a credential, whether labelled (apikey=) or in a known token format (provider keys, a bearer value, a JWT, a URL carrying a password). reviewmode="guardrails" on marmdistill makes the same…
